items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: he loved, again, a guy named Phil Moore

ctx.x: The arranger for Dizzy Gillespie. He took a liking to me. I don’t know why. But he sort of took me under his wing, and he took me out to lunch many, many times. And basically he just poured out his life story to me. He felt like he’d been basically forgotten. He was

very proud of the one article that talked about him, Leonard Feather wrote the article in fact, about Gil Fuller. And he was very proud of that article, that at least somebody recognized his talents. And he was telling me all the things he did that he didn’t get credit for, and of course I found out later that he also was a fantastic liar in a lot of ways, and exaggerator, and he exaggerated a lot of his accomplishments. And I won’t say – I mean I don’t know to what degree he did, but I have since found out that…
I have a picture of an LP I had, “Last Train from Overbrook.” I think it was James Moody.
